name: Aoi Futaba
source: Futaba is the only daughter of the owners of a  Western-style restaurant "Cosmos" in front of the station and works there as a waitress. She has a social phobia, but the store has a poor reputation. Futaba decides to change herself inspired by a fellow waitress who becomes more cheerful because of getting a boyfriend.
